```python
# Context variable usage
text_len = len(moon_page)

marathon_km = 42.195
perigee_km = 356400  # Minimum perigee on Wikipedia page for Moon

# 2022 Berlin Marathon World Record: 2 hours, 1 minute, 9 seconds
time_2022_sec = 2 * 3600 + 1 * 60 + 9
time_2022_hrs = time_2022_sec / 3600

# 2018 Berlin Marathon World Record: 2 hours, 1 minute, 39 seconds
time_2018_sec = 2 * 3600 + 1 * 60 + 39
time_2018_hrs = time_2018_sec / 3600

# INEOS 1:59 Challenge: 1 hour, 59 minutes, 40.2 seconds
time_ineos_sec = 1 * 3600 + 59 * 60 + 40.2
time_ineos_hrs = time_ineos_sec / 3600

# Calculation for each
speed_2022 = marathon_km / time_2022_hrs
total_hours_2022 = perigee_km / speed_2022
thousand_hours_2022 = total_hours_2022 / 1000

speed_2018 = marathon_km / time_2018_hrs
total_hours_2018 = perigee_km / speed_2018
thousand_hours_2018 = total_hours_2018 / 1000

speed_ineos = marathon_km / time_ineos_hrs
total_hours_ineos = perigee_km / speed_ineos
thousand_hours_ineos = total_hours_ineos / 1000

calc_results = {
    "2022_WR": {
        "speed": speed_2022,
        "total_hours": total_hours_2022,
        "thousand_hours": thousand_hours_2022,
        "rounded_thousand_hours": round(thousand_hours_2022),
        "rounded_to_nearest_1000_hours": round(total_hours_2022, -3)
    },
    "2018_WR": {
        "speed": speed_2018,
        "total_hours": total_hours_2018,
        "thousand_hours": thousand_hours_2018,
        "rounded_thousand_hours": round(thousand_hours_2018),
        "rounded_to_nearest_1000_hours": round(total_hours_2018, -3)
    },
    "INEOS_159": {
        "speed": speed_ineos,
        "total_hours": total_hours_ineos,
        "thousand_hours": thousand_hours_ineos,
        "rounded_thousand_hours": round(thousand_hours_ineos),
        "rounded_to_nearest_1000_hours": round(total_hours_ineos, -3)
    }
}

print(calc_results)
```
